name: chain-list
code:
a = [2]
print(1 < 2 in a)
print(1 < 2 in [2])

name: chain-dict-view
code:
k = {2:3}.keys()
print(1 < 2 in k)
print(1 < 2 in {2:3}.keys())

name: chain-grouped
code:
k = {2:3}.keys()
print(1 < 2 and 2 in k)
print((1 < 2) and (2 in k))
print(2 in k)

name: chain-not-in
code:
k = {2:3}.keys()
print(1 < 3 not in k)
print(1 < 2 not in k)
